description: T-0969 attempt 8: Excel's Gamma-ratio prefactor per df. Calc: column A is df (1 to 200, then 250 to 1000 by 50); B T.DIST.RT(0.5,df) (centre path), C T.DIST.RT(2,df) and F T.DIST.RT(1.5,df) (rounded-y path), D and E T.DIST(0.5|2,df,FALSE). Exact: column A is t = 1 + k/2^20 and 0.25 + k/2^22 (t*t and df + t*t exact in doubles); B to E the density at df 3, 4, 5, 7.
